tasks.title: Scaffold calculator UI and project structure
tasks.description:
STATUS (lead): complete on branch gc-t01-scaffold at aeb878a. This sandbox has no usable GitHub remote/credentials (local-only origin, GH_TOKEN invalid), so no PR can be opened. The branch is the deliverable; the user will merge it from the agent workspace. Do not retry push/PR creation.

Build the static, no-build foundation for a graphing calculator web app at the repo root. No frameworks, no npm, no build step: plain HTML/CSS/JS loaded with classic <script> tags so index.html works when opened directly from disk.

Layout (desktop side-by-side, stacked on mobile, dark theme):
- Header: title "Graphing Calculator" and an angle-mode toggle (Radians / Degrees).
- Left column, calculator card: expression display (current expression + result area), text input for expressions, and a keypad: 7-9 ÷, 4-6 ×, 1-3 −, 0 . = +, plus AC, backspace, ( ), ^, and quick keys sin cos tan sqrt pi.
- Left column, "Functions" card: "f(x) =" input, "Plot" button, empty list container with helper text "Add a function to plot it."
- Right column, graph card: <canvas>, toolbar (Zoom in, Zoom out, Reset view), and a small coordinate readout element.
- A status/error line in the calculator card.

js/main.js wires keypad clicks to the expression input (digits/operators/AC/backspace), keyboard typing, and toolbar buttons to graph.zoomIn()/zoomOut()/resetView() only. No math evaluation yet.

Create working stubs with this exact contract:
- js/math.js: window.MathEngine = { evaluate(expression, x = 0) { throw new Error('Math engine not implemented'); }, setAngleMode(mode) {}, getAngleMode() { return 'rad'; } }
- js/graph.js: window.GraphRenderer = { create(canvas, options) { return { render(functions) {}, zoomIn() {}, zoomOut() {}, resetView() {}, getView() { return { xMin: -10, xMax: 10, yMin: -6, yMax: 6 }; } }; } }

Canvas must fill its container. CSS in css/styles.css using CSS variables, responsive at the 900px breakpoint.

Files: index.html, css/styles.css, js/main.js, js/math.js, js/graph.js
tasks.doneWhen: Opening index.html shows the complete responsive two-column layout; keypad and keyboard edit the expression input; AC/backspace work; toolbar buttons call the graph API; no console errors. Branch + PR.

tasks.title: Implement math expression parser and evaluator
tasks.description:
DELIVERED (lead accepted): branch gc-t02-math at 7ad08b7, stacked on gc-t01-scaffold. Parser/evaluator + tests/math.test.html complete; smoke checks passed. No PR (sandbox has no GitHub remote/credentials).

Implement js/math.js (classic script, replaces the stub) as the math engine. Keep the contract: window.MathEngine with evaluate(expression, x = 0) returning a Number, setAngleMode('rad'|'deg'), getAngleMode().

Requirements:
- Tokenizer + parser (recursive descent or shunting-yard), no eval()/Function().
- Numbers incl. decimals and scientific notation; variable x; constants pi/π and e.
- Unary +/-; binary + - * / ^ with correct precedence; ^ right-associative; parentheses.
- Implicit multiplication: 2x, 3(x+1), 2sin(x), x(x+1), (x+1)(x-1).
- Functions: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, sqrt, abs, ln, log (base 10), exp, floor, ceil, round, min(a,b), max(a,b), pow(a,b). Trig respects angle mode for inputs and inverse outputs.
- Throw clear Error messages for unknown identifiers, unbalanced parentheses, malformed input, wrong arg counts; suitable for inline UI display.
- Division by zero may return Infinity (needed for graphing).

Tests: create tests/math.test.html + tests/math.test.js loaded with classic script tags; page shows a pass/fail list and a summary. Cover precedence, associativity, unary minus, implicit multiplication, constants, every function, deg/rad, x substitution, and error cases. All tests must pass in the browser.

Files: js/math.js, tests/math.test.html, tests/math.test.js
tasks.doneWhen: tests/math.test.html shows all tests passing; MathEngine.evaluate handles 2x^2 + sin(pi/2), 2^3^2 -> 512, sqrt(16)/4 -> 1; friendly errors on 2+, foo(3), (1+2. Branch + PR.

tasks.title: Wire calculator evaluation, history, and function list
tasks.description:
DELIVERED (lead accepted): branch gc-t03-calculator at d13db9a, stacked on gc-t02-math. Live preview, =/Enter evaluation, 20-entry history, function list add/hide/delete, angle toggle, toolbar wiring. No PR (sandbox has no GitHub remote/credentials).

Implement the calculator behavior in js/main.js on top of the scaffold UI and MathEngine.

- Live preview: evaluate the current expression with x=0 after a short debounce and show the result; invalid input shows a friendly inline message instead of crashing.
- Evaluate: = or Enter evaluates and shows the result prominently; AC clears; backspace deletes; keyboard shortcuts work while the expression input is focused.
- History: keep the last 20 evaluated expressions in a list; clicking an entry restores it to the input. In-memory only.
- Function plotting: "Plot" button (and Enter in the f(x) input) adds { id, expression, color, visible } to the functions array, color from a cycling palette; clear the input; render the list with color swatch, expression, show/hide toggle, delete button; empty state helper text. Call GraphRenderer.create(canvas, { onCursorMove }) once at startup and graph.render(functions) after every add/remove/toggle. Reject empty input; on syntax errors show inline error and do not add.
- Angle-mode toggle switches MathEngine.setAngleMode and re-renders the graph.
- Toolbar buttons zoom in/out/reset call the GraphRenderer API.

Files: js/main.js, index.html, css/styles.css
tasks.doneWhen: Calculator evaluates real expressions with graceful errors; history restores entries; adding/removing/hiding functions updates the list and calls graph.render; angle toggle works; no console errors. Branch + PR.

tasks.title: Build interactive canvas graphing engine
tasks.description:
DELIVERED (lead accepted): branch gc-t04-graph at 75ed449, stacked on gc-t03-calculator. Real canvas plotter: hi-DPI, adaptive grid/axes + labels, per-pixel sampling, multi-colored function curves, wheel zoom at cursor, drag pan, zoom/reset API, onCursorMove. No PR (sandbox has no GitHub remote/credentials).

Implement js/graph.js (classic script, replaces the stub) as a real function plotter. Keep window.GraphRenderer = { create(canvas, options) } returning { render(functions), zoomIn(), zoomOut(), resetView(), getView() }.

- Hi-DPI canvas sizing; redraw on ResizeObserver and render().
- Adaptive grid and axes with numeric tick labels and origin; theme-aware colors (match css variables or dark palette).
- Plot each visible function by sampling MathEngine.evaluate(expression, x) per device-pixel column; break lines on NaN/Infinity; clamp extremes; 1.5–2px colored strokes using function.color; skip invalid expressions quietly.
- Default view x in [-10, 10], y in [-6, 6]. zoomIn/zoomOut ~1.25x around center; resetView restores default. Wheel zoom around cursor; drag to pan; cursor feedback.
- Report cursor coordinates through options.onCursorMove({x, y}) for the main UI readout.
- Redraw via requestAnimationFrame for pan/zoom; support multiple functions.

Files: js/graph.js, css/styles.css
tasks.doneWhen: Multiple expressions plot as correctly colored curves; labeled grid/axes; wheel zoom centered on cursor; drag pan; toolbar zoom/reset works; coordinate readout updates on hover; crisp on resize; no console errors. Branch + PR.
